patches.name: Skip injected ads
patches.description: Turns YouTube for Android TV into the standalone ad-free YouTube TV app "YT TV+" (see this app's description), and removes the ads YouTube injects into YouTube TV on-demand videos and DVR recordings, plus ad and analytics tracking. It does not patch regular YouTube. Live broadcast commercials are part of the broadcast and still play. Sign in with an activation code at tv.youtube.com/start.

compatiblePackages.name: YouTube TV (Android TV)
compatiblePackages.description: IMPORTANT: this patches the YouTube FOR Android TV app (com.google.android.youtube.tv), but it does NOT give you regular YouTube. It converts that app into a separate, ad-free YouTube TV app called "YT TV+" that loads the YouTube TV live and DVR service and removes the ads YouTube injects into it. YT TV+ installs alongside the original app, so regular YouTube for Android TV is left untouched. (YouTube TV's own app, com.google.android.youtube.tvunplugged, runs on a different engine and cannot be patched; this is the way to an ad-free YouTube TV on Android TV.)
